posts.title: Restarting your PC wipes your data

slides.text: Restarting your PC wipes your data
THE TRUTH — A restart clears memory and caches only — files, settings and apps are untouched. That fear is the exact reason so many people never reboot, and their PCs stay broken because of it.
Share this with the person who still believes it.
